ValidationRule.description: Frequent Flyer Information - Restrict user from editing the frequent flyer record when the status is "Pending with Sales Solutions"
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(($Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator'), ($Profile.Name <> 'Qantas System Administrator'), ($Profile.Name <> 'Qantas System Admin - Freight'), ($Profile.Name <> 'Qantas System Admin - QCC'), ($Profile.Name <> 'Qantas System Admin - SND'), ISPICKVAL( Case__r.Status , "Pending with Sales Solutions"), OR( ISNEW(), OR( CreatedDate <> LastModifiedDate , ISCHANGED(Name), ISCHANGED(Current_Tier__c), ISCHANGED(Freq_Flyer_Expiry_Date__c), ISCHANGED(Frequent_Flyer_Number__c), ISCHANGED(Request_Type__c), ISCHANGED(Upgrade_Tier_Requested__c), ISCHANGED(Case__c))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Frequent Flyer Information record should not be edited if the Status is ‘Pending with Sales Solutions'
